'''Alex Alcalde''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 31 FL from Indianapolis, In. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Gold 31 FL || Indianapolis, In || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Other sourced notes ==

Gold 31 FL, Indianapolis, Indiana. RFD broadcast 9 (26 February 1999) included a squadron/ambassador call-in with Chris Swearingen, Alex Alcalde, Mike Hardy, and Guy Kargl.

He posted two [[Young Jedi]] lists on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)]] as '''Gold 31''': ''Wizards!'' (Jedi) and ''All Droids All the time!'' (Sith). Archived copies: [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/jedi1.html jedi1.html] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20011202101302/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/decks/jedi1.html Wayback, 2 December 2001]; [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/sith1.html sith1.html] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009020148/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/sith1.html Wayback, 9 October 2026].
